message.content:
Reflection across the line spanned by \(\begin{pmatrix}1\\5\end{pmatrix}\) has eigenvalues:

- \(1\) along the reflecting line,
- \(-1\) perpendicular to the reflecting line.

Thus,
\[
\det \mathbf{R}=1\cdot(-1)=-1.
\]

Alternatively, using the reflection matrix formula,
\[
\mathbf{R}=\frac{2}{v\cdot v}vv^T-I
\]
with \(v=\begin{pmatrix}1\\5\end{pmatrix}\), \(v\cdot v=26\),
\[
\mathbf{R}=\frac{2}{26}\begin{pmatrix}1&5\\5&25\end{pmatrix}-I
=\begin{pmatrix}-12/13&5/13\\5/13&12/13\end{pmatrix}.
\]
So
\[
\det\mathbf{R}=\left(-\frac{12}{13}\right)\left(\frac{12}{13}\right)-\left(\frac{5}{13}\right)^2
=-\frac{144}{169}-\frac{25}{169}=-1.
\]

The answer is \(-1\).
